about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm Yuval Elbar. I do security research — mostly finding and reporting bugs in cloud platforms and AI infrastructure. I come from a software background, so I read the code rather than fuzz blindly.
This is where I write things up once they're fixed. Everything was reported privately and patched before going public. Some of it also ran in Digital Whisper and on the Cycode blog.
